question.text: What will Nvidia's (NVDA) closing share price be on Friday, November 27, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing price of NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) common stock in the regular trading session of Friday, November 27, 2026 (a scheduled shortened session that closes at 1:00 p.m. ET), as reported in the "Close" column of the historical prices table at https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/ for the row dated November 27, 2026, using the value as originally published for that date (not any later revision reflecting a subsequent stock split or corporate action). The answer is the price in US dollars per share as published by that source (e.g., a published close of 158.42 resolves as 158.42). If that page is unavailable or does not display a November 27, 2026 row, the "Close" value for that date at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/history/ is used instead. If no regular trading session is held on November 27, 2026, the question is annulled.

research:
I couldn't find any information that settles this question yet. NVDA last closed at $156.14 on 2026-11-16, its lowest close since July 2025. Q3 FY2027 earnings come after the close on Nov 17, and options price a move of roughly 9 to 10% for the report.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-16: Yahoo history page ("At close: November 16") shows these recent closes: Nov 2 202.06; Nov 3 206.69; Nov 4 200.13; Nov 5 181.60; Nov 6 186.64; Nov 9 178.67; Nov 10 168.89; Nov 11 173.73; Nov 12 166.19 (intraday low 148.80, volume 748M); Nov 13 162.85; **Nov 16 156.14** (range 155.02 to 163.00, volume 330M). [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/)
- The background put the Nov 13 close at about $159.2. Yahoo shows **162.85**, which matches aktiencheck's "Friday close of $162.85". Use Yahoo's figure.
- The stockanalysis.com backup page loaded, but no price rows came through in the raw text. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the outcome yet. The stock is down about 24% from its Nov 3 close of 206.69, in 9 sessions. Earnings come after the close on Nov 17, and 7 sessions follow before the Nov 27 half-day.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: NVDA closed down 4.12% at $156.14, its lowest close since 2025-07-01, on volume about 119% above the 3-month average. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/16/stock-market-today-nov-16-nvidia-sinks-as-u-s-tightens-ai-chip-restrictions-and-analysts-slash-price-targets/), [Implicator](https://www.implicator.ai/nvidia-stock-16-month-low-q3-earnings/)
- 2026-11-16: The Commerce Department's export-control bureau (BIS) issued an interim final rule. It requires licenses to ship advanced AI chips to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, and limits remote access to chips in third-country data centers. Benzinga says tech stocks lost about $960B. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-16/us-moves-to-limit-remote-access-to-advanced-ai-chips), [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/nvidia-stock-falls-as-u-s-expands-ai-chip-export-restrictions-to-five-more-countries), [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/11/63320949/tech-stocks-960-billion-china-ai-chips-remote-access-rule)
- 2026-11-16: Nvidia's own guidance for the quarter is $108B revenue ±2%, about 12% above the prior quarter. [Coinpaper](https://coinpaper.com/38892/nvidia-reports-earnings-november-17-after-nvda-stock-plunged-nearly-13-in-a-week-investors-await-108-b-revenue-ai-chip-demand-and-margin-guidance)
- 2026-11-16: The Anthropic IPO is the other big AI-sentiment test this period. [Bolsamania](https://www.bolsamania.com/capitalbolsa/noticias/gurus-de-mercado/comentario-de-apertura-nvidia-y-anthropic-ponen-a-prueba-el-apetito-de-wall-street-por-la-ia--24183704.html)
- 2026-11-12/13: Huang resigned, Colette Kress became interim CEO and the stock fell about 13% for the week (per the background and Investopedia). [Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-nasdaq-11162026-12257790)

## 4. Base rates
- Implied earnings move:
  - Benzinga: about 9.6% as of Nov 12 (Thursday), the largest since Aug 2024. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/opinion/26/11/63240720/options-traders-expect-nvidia-biggest-earnings-move-since-2024)
  - EarningsWatcher: ±9.2% as of Nov 14, against a 10-year average of ±7.8%. The stock beat the implied move in 5 of the last 17 reports. [EarningsWatcher](https://earnings-watcher.com/wiki/nvda-earnings-november-2026)
  - Equibles: the Nov 18 $160 straddle cost $17.20 (10.7%). It estimates the report-only move at 6.2% to 6.9%. [Equibles](https://equibles.com/research/nvidia-nvda-earnings-implied-move-options-price-about-6-to-7-for-the-report-itself)
  - Earlier quarters for comparison: 5.4% implied for Aug 2026 and 6.5% for May 2026. The average actual move was about 7.4% over 12 quarters. [HL/Reuters](https://www.hl.co.uk/news/nvidia-earnings-could-spark-200-billion-swing-in-shares-options-show)
- Same window in 2025 (Yahoo): Nov 17, 2025 close 186.60, Nov 28, 2025 close 177.00 (−5.1%). Earnings day Nov 20, 2025 opened at 195.95 and closed at 180.64. Gains right after a report can reverse.
- Statistical baseline (8 sessions, normal-vol history, from 156.14): p5 140.1, p25 151.0, p50 157.6, p75 165.6, p95 177.7. Current volatility is far higher, about 4% average daily moves recently, so the true spread is probably wider than this.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "NVDA hit week of Nov 16" (closes Nov 20, upside levels only): ↑$168 at 45.5%; ↑$172 at 34%; ↑$176 at 25.5%; ↑$180 at 19%; ↑$188 at 13%. These are touch probabilities, not closing prices.
- Polymarket "NVDA hit in November": upside levels of $224 and above all at 2.5% or less. The ↑$264 contract shows 7.3%, which looks like a stale or illiquid quote. No downside levels were captured.
- Polymarket "beat quarterly earnings": 87% Yes.
- Polymarket end-2026 market cap: below $4.0T at 56%. Roughly 24.3B shares means about $165/share. I estimated that share count; it is not from a source.
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold NVDA price market for Nov 27. The Kalshi earnings-day markets are about commodities and do not apply.
- Analyst targets: Baird cut its target from $500 to $200 (per the background). I could not get a consensus target.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17: Q3 FY27 results after the close, call at 5 p.m. ET. Nov 18 is the first trading reaction. Things to watch: revenue against the $108B guide, Q4 guidance, the export-rule impact, and commentary on leadership. [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)
- Possible news on the CEO search (reported candidates: Rene Haas, Chris Malachowsky), timing of Huang's congressional testimony, and the export rule's publication in the Federal Register.
- The Anthropic IPO, AI-sector sentiment and the inflation data driving the Nov 16 futures selloff.
- Markets are closed Nov 26 and close at 1 p.m. ET on Nov 27, which falls before month-end flows, so the session will be thin. [NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars)

Other sources: [Benzinga implied move](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/earnings/26/11/63277064/nvidia-earnings-without-jensen-huang-implied-move-bending-spoons), [aktiencheck](https://aktiencheck.de/artikel/nvidia-aktie-dow-jones-verlierer-am-tag-vor-den-zahlen-rutscht-der-chipkonzern), [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zacharyfolk/2026/11/16/us-closes-loophole-that-allowed-china-to-remotely-access-nvidia-chips/), [Investing.com](https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nvidia-stock-may-move-67-on-nov-17-earnings-report-93CH-4972192), [Trefis](https://www.trefis.com/stock/nvda/articles/625122/nvidia-earnings-ahead-what-past-reactions-say-about-the-stock/2026-11-16)

I could not find any published Q3 results or after-hours reaction yet. The last confirmed close is **$156.14 on 2026-11-16**. Earnings come out after today's close, and options were pricing a move of roughly 6% to 8% on the report. Your background figure for Nov 13 (about $159.2) conflicts with several sources that put it at $162.85.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-17: I fetched the StockAnalysis history page (the backup source), but the price table loads by script and the text version showed no rows. I could not read Yahoo's history table directly. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/history/)
- 2026-11-16: The Yahoo Finance quote shows a $156.14 close, down 4.12%. Volume was 326.6M shares, about 119% above the 3-month average of 148.9M. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/), [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/16/stock-market-today-nov-16-nvidia-sinks-as-u-s-tightens-ai-chip-restrictions-and-analysts-slash-price-targets/)
- **Conflict on the Nov 13 close:** Aktiencheck gives a Friday close of $162.85. Yahoo's live page showed "-7.14 (-4.38%)" at $155.71, which also implies a prior close of $162.85. Your background says about $159.2. A 4.12% drop to $156.14 also works back to about $162.85, so $162.85 looks more likely to be right. [aktiencheck](https://aktiencheck.de/artikel/nvidia-aktie-dow-jones-verlierer-am-tag-vor-den-zahlen-rutscht-der-chipkonzern)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Q3 FY2027 report comes out after the close on 2026-11-17, and that is the biggest single move expected before resolution.
- The stock closed Nov 13 at its lowest since July 2025, about 32% below its Oct 6 record. [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: The Commerce Department issued an interim final rule blocking companies in countries such as China from reaching high-end chips through remote servers abroad. NVDA was the Dow's worst performer that day. [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html)
- 2026-11-16: CNBC reported, citing a source, that the board is not considering bringing Huang back and is focused on a national security investigation. Trump said he "would not mind" seeing Huang reinstated. A Yahoo headline says Elon Musk joined calls to reinstate him. Polymarket odds of Huang taking a formal role by year-end went from about 20% to about 11%. [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-falls-4-ahead-earnings-141051719.html)
- 2026-11-16: Six straight weekly losses, the longest streak since 2012, and about $1.7T of market value gone. A NYT report alleged Alice Huang helped smuggle chips into China, which Nvidia denies. Congressional Democrats are looking into the administration's approvals of chip sales to China. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-earnings-jensen-huang-resignation.html)
- 2026-11-15: The FT reported Huang had discussed a return, with allies setting up a lobbying "war room." [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html)
- Week of Nov 9-13: At least 10 analysts downgraded the stock to Hold. Bernstein moved to Market Perform with a $200 target, and Baird cut its target to $200. On Nov 16, UBS's Arcuri called the market's implied view of a 2028 peak "incredibly draconian." [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-interim-ceo-kress-prepares-for-q3-earnings-with-huang-reportedly-planning-comeback-153114076.html)
- Consensus for the quarter: revenue about $109.1B (LSEG) or $109.15B (Bloomberg), EPS $2.47, data center about $101.85B. Company guidance was $108B ±2%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-earnings-jensen-huang-resignation.html), [Coinpaper](https://coinpaper.com/38892/nvidia-reports-earnings-november-17-after-nvda-stock-plunged-nearly-13-in-a-week-investors-await-108-b-revenue-ai-chip-demand-and-margin-guidance)

## 4. Base rates
- Your statistical baseline, which ignores the earnings event, gives 8-day percentiles of p5 $140.1, p25 $151.0, p50 $157.6, p75 $165.6 and p95 $177.7. The upcoming report probably makes the real spread wider than this.
- Of the last 20 earnings reports, 11 had a positive next-day move and 9 a negative one. After the 2026-08-26 report the stock rose 8.7% the next day. [Trefis](https://www.trefis.com/stock/nvda/articles/625122/nvidia-earnings-ahead-what-past-reactions-say-about-the-stock/2026-11-16)
- Typical earnings moves: the 10-year average is ±8.4%, the median ±6.6%, and the 95th percentile ±20.1%. For the August 2026 report options implied ±5.4%, against a 12-quarter average move of 7.4%. [EarningsWatcher](https://earnings-watcher.com/wiki/nvda-earnings-november-2026), [ORATS](https://orats.com/blog/nvidia-options-280-billion-earnings-swing)
- Calendar effect: the day after Thanksgiving is usually a low-volume, half-day session that tends to drift up slightly. I did not pull NVDA's exact moves for that day in past years.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Options-implied move for this report: ±7.9% as of Nov 3 (EarningsWatcher). Pepperstone gives ±6.2%, but its date may be off. I did not find a current figure that reflects the CEO turmoil; it is probably higher. [EarningsWatcher](https://earnings-watcher.com/wiki/nvda-earnings-november-2026), [Pepperstone](https://pepperstone.com/en/analysis/navigating-markets/nvidia-q3-2026-earnings-preview-key-numbers-market-impact-trading-insights/)
- Polymarket "NVDA hit week of Nov 16" (prices as of 2026-11-17 00:51 UTC): ↑$168 at 45.5%, ↑$172 at 34%, ↑$176 at 25.5%, ↑$180 at 19%, ↑$188 at 13%.
- Polymarket "beat quarterly earnings": 87%.
- Polymarket end-2026 market cap: below $4.00T at 56%, $4.0-4.5T at 24%.
- Kalshi: none of the collected Kalshi markets ask about the NVDA share price.
- Analyst targets cluster around $200 after the cuts (Baird, Bernstein).

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-17 after the close: Q3 FY2027 results, with the call at 5pm ET hosted by interim CEO Kress. Q4 guidance is the key number. [Nvidia](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)
- The Anthropic IPO is coming up, a test of investor appetite for AI. [Bolsamania](https://www.bolsamania.com/capitalbolsa/noticias/gurus-de-mercado/comentario-de-apertura-nvidia-y-anthropic-ponen-a-prueba-el-apetito-de-wall-street-por-la-ia--24183704.html)
- Other things that could move the stock:
  - news on the CEO search (Haas, Malachowsky)
  - talk of a Huang comeback
  - Huang's appearance before Congress (no date found)
  - the board's national security investigation
  - possible further export rules
- 2026-11-26: Markets closed for Thanksgiving. 2026-11-27: half-day session closing at 1pm ET, with the last full session on Nov 25.
